notes: Omarchy binds F9 and SUPER + CTRL + X to Voxtype when it is installed (default/hypr/bindings/voxtype.lua); the snippet takes those keys over with unbind lines, so load it after Omarchy's defaults.
Hyprland fires the release binding when the key of the chord comes up; release the modifiers last.
result.text:
# Dettivo dictation bindings. Generated by `dettivo setup hyprland`; change the
# keys in ~/.config/dettivo/config.toml ([hotkeys]) and run it again.
# Load it from hyprland.conf: source = ~/.config/hypr/dettivo.conf
# Omarchy binds the same keys to Voxtype; unbind takes them over.
unbind = , F9
unbind = SUPER CTRL, X
# Hold to talk: press starts, release stops.
bind = , F9, exec, dettivo --quiet dictation start
bindr = , F9, exec, dettivo --quiet dictation stop
# Toggle: one press starts, the next stops.
bind = SUPER CTRL, X, exec, dettivo --quiet dictation toggle
bind = SUPER CTRL, Escape, exec, dettivo --quiet dictation cancel
bind = SUPER CTRL SHIFT, X, exec, dettivo --quiet dictation reinsert-last
